title: SEVI: Safe Evidential Real-World Reinforcement Learning
description:
arXiv:2610.31829v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Real-world reinforcement learning has enabled contact-rich manipulation tasks to be trained directly on physical robots, but unsafe interactions during online learning remain a key barrier to practical deployment. We propose Safe Evidential Real-World Reinforcement Learning (SEVI), a framework for reliability-aware safety intervention during real-world policy learning.
